summary: This bill appropriates funds for the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) during any federal government shutdown in fiscal year 2026, ensuring payments continue at the same rate as the previous year.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly appropriates funds for LIHEAP during a government shutdown, ensuring continued payments. This directly increases government spending during such periods.

The bill's sole purpose is to appropriate 'such sums as may be necessary' from the Treasury for LIHEAP payments during any FY2026 government shutdown, with no offsets or spending reductions specified. This directly increases federal outlays to maintain program funding, thereby pushing toward acceptance of a larger deficit to sustain the priority.
